description: This file defines utility functions and constants for managing local storage keys and values in a web application, including legacy and new key patterns, with functions for safely getting and setting items.

methods.name: dangerouslyGetItemDoNotUse
methods.description: Retrieves a value from local storage by key with JSON parsing, returns default if not found or on error.

methods.name: dangerouslySetItemDoNotUse
methods.description: Sets a value in local storage by key with JSON stringification, silently fails if error occurs.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Type-safe wrapper to retrieve a typed value from local storage using predefined keys.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Type-safe wrapper to store a typed value in local storage using predefined keys.
